ORDER UNDER SECTION 92 OF THENATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD
ACT No. 02 OF 1974

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 2 of 1974,I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning & Water Supply, here by approve the acquisition of the immovable property,described in the following schedule, as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, for the constructionof Meekanuwa Pump-house of Kundasale-Haragama Water Supply Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning & Water Supply.
Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply,No. 35, “Lakdiya Medura”,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla.23rd October 20175/2/1/1298
Schedule

An allotment of land called Thenne Kumbura Watta in total extent of about 18 perches situated at village of Thennekumburain No. 275, Thennekumbura Grama Niladhari Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kandy Kadawatsathara andGangawata Korale in Kandy District and bounded as follows:-

North by:Road from Ampitiya to Thennekumbura;East by:Road from Ampitiya to Thennekumbura and remaining portion of the same land;South by:Lot No. 1 of Licensed Survey Plan No. 0178 A (Internal Road);West by:Lot No. 1 of Licensed Survey Plan No. 0178 A (Internal Road) and remaining portion of the same land.
